extDescription.message: A friendly buddy that explains risky messages, stops risky clicks and helps you recover.

confirmTitle.message: Send this for a detailed check?

confirmIntro.message: Purrtect will send this to Google Gemini. Personal details are already hidden. Nothing is stored.

confirmNever.message: Your name, email address and phone number are never sent.

dontAskAgain.message: Don't ask again (change this in Settings)

notSentNote.message: Not sent. This is the quick check done in your browser. Tap the sign to check in detail.

askBeforeHelp.message: "Ask me every time" shows exactly what will be sent, with personal details hidden, and waits for your OK.

askBeforeShort_on.message: Shows what's sent and waits for your OK.

info_country.message: Used for the recovery plan: which helplines and reporting websites to show if you clicked or paid.

info_language.message: Language for Purrtect's buttons, warnings and explanations, and for reading them aloud.

info_voice.message: Shows a Listen button on each result so it can be read aloud. Turn off to hide it.

info_careful.message:
How easily Purrtect raises a warning:
• Relaxed: only clear warning signs, fewer alerts.
• Normal: balanced (recommended).
• Strict: even small warning signs, more alerts and more detailed checks.

careful_relaxed.message: Only clear warning signs. Fewer alerts.

careful_strict.message: Even small warning signs. More alerts.

home_manualHint.message: Select text and tap Check with Purrtect.

home_pausedHint.message: Turn off Pause to start checking again.

home_other.message: Works on Gmail and WhatsApp Web

home_otherHint.message: On other sites, select text, right-click and choose Scan with Purrtect.

home_refreshHint.message: Purrtect was installed or updated after this page opened.

info_pause.message: Stops automatic checks and hides the signs on this site until you turn it back on. Selecting text to check still works.

info_cursorCat.message: A small cat follows your cursor on Gmail and WhatsApp Web. Rest the cursor on a link and it shows where the link really goes (✓ fine, ! careful, ⚠ risky). It naps when you're idle, watches you type, and runs to a warning so you notice it. It never blocks clicks.

info_catEverywhere.message: The cat also comes along on other websites. There it only checks when you ask: rest the cursor on a link to see where it really goes, or select text and press "Check with Purrtect". Chrome asks for permission first. Refresh open tabs after turning it on.

noVoice.message: No voice for this language is installed on this device.

localCheckOnly.message: Checked in your browser. Nothing was sent anywhere.

basicCheckOnly.message: Basic check only: the full check is not available right now.

advice_green.message: If something still feels wrong, ask someone you trust.

advice_yellow.message: Contact the company yourself using its official app or the number on your card.

advice_red.message: Don't click, reply or pay. Delete the message.

hitwhy_ip_link.message: Real companies use names in their web addresses, not just numbers.

hitwhy_lookalike.message: The link looks like a well-known company, but it is not their real website.

hit_display_name_claim.message: Pretends to be an official body

hitwhy_display_name_claim.message: The name says bank, courier or government, but it doesn't come from them.

hit_shortener.message: Short link hides where it goes

hitwhy_shortener.message: You can't see the real website before you tap.

hitwhy_plain_http.message: Banks and shops always use secure https links.

hitwhy_risky_tld.message: Endings like .top or .xyz are often used by scammers.

hitwhy_urgency.message: Scammers rush you so you don't stop to think.

hit_money_secret.message: Asks for money or secret codes

hitwhy_money_secret.message: Nobody real needs your OTP, PIN or a fee to give you money.

hitwhy_new_sender.message: You haven't heard from them before.

enteredAnything.message: Entered anything? Tap here for help

clickWarningBody.message: It goes to $1. Real banks and companies never ask for codes or passwords through links like this.

buddyHint.message: Select any text and tap me to check it, or right-click and choose Scan with Purrtect.

nothingToScan.message: Nothing to check. Select text or a link, then right-click.

neverAsk.message: Purrtect will never ask for your OTP, PIN, password or full card number.

happened_installed_app.message: Installed an app or gave screen access

reassurance.message: Don't worry: this happens to careful people too. Acting quickly helps a lot.

callBankFallback.message: Call your bank on the number printed on your card or in its official app.

draftBank.message: Message to your bank or wallet

basicPlanOnly.message: Basic plan only: the personal plan is not available right now.

basic_now_1.message: Call your bank, card or wallet on the number printed on your card or in the official app. Ask them to block it and stop any transfers.

basic_now_2.message: Call the helpline for your country listed below.

basic_now_3.message: Change the password you typed, and uninstall any app you were asked to install.

basic_today_1.message: Report it on your country's official reporting website.

basic_today_2.message: Sign out of other devices and turn on two-step sign-in.

basic_next_1.message: Check your bank statements every day for a week.

basic_next_2.message: Anyone who offers to get your money back for a fee is another scammer.

tagline.message: Explains scams, stops risky clicks, helps you recover.

consent_checked.message: Purrtect checks messages and links you open in Gmail and WhatsApp Web, right in your browser.

consent_sent.message: Only suspicious items can be sent for a closer check, with names, numbers and codes hidden. By default you see each one and choose before it is sent.

consent_never.message: Nothing is stored on our server. Your settings stay in this browser.

consent_secrets.message: We never ask for your OTP, PIN, password or full card number.

modeHelp.message: Auto checks every link, and the full text from new senders. Manual checks only what you pick.

dataHelp.message: Clears trusted senders, "This is safe" choices and saved link checks.

web_tagline.message: Paste a message, enter a link or upload a screenshot. Your buddy explains what it finds.

web_text_placeholder.message: Paste the email, SMS or WhatsApp message here.

web_image_label.message: Screenshot (PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 4 MB)

web_image_notice.message: A screenshot can't have its numbers hidden first. It is checked in memory and then dropped, never stored. Crop out anything private.

web_install_2.message: Open chrome://extensions and turn on Developer mode.

web_install_3.message: Click Load unpacked and choose the unzipped folder.

web_privacy.message: Names, numbers and codes in pasted text are hidden before checking. Nothing is stored.

web_result_empty.message: Paste a message or pick a sample scam. Your result shows up here.

web_error.message: Please paste a message, enter a link or choose a screenshot.

web_image_needs_ai.message: Screenshots need the full check, which is not available right now. Please try again in a minute.

lc_whyHidden.message: This button hides its web address, so it can't be checked here. Be careful, or ask Gemini to check the message.

lc_whyNone.message: Nothing worrying in the web address. Still, never type a password or OTP after clicking a link in a message.

lc_whyMessage.message: The message this link is in looks risky.

draftIn_en.message: These drafts are in English, the language the police and banks there use. Fill in the [brackets] before sending.

draftIn_hi.message: These drafts are in Hindi, which the police and banks in India accept. Fill in the [brackets] before sending.

draftIn_ja.message: These drafts are in Japanese, the language the police and banks in Japan use. Fill in the [brackets] before sending.

draftIn_id.message: These drafts are in Indonesian, the language the police and banks in Indonesia use. Fill in the [brackets] before sending.
